name: durable-managed-cross-provider-runs
title: Durable managed cross-provider CLI runs and receipt-bound review evidence
description: Implement the approved ManagedHostRun boundary for CLI-launched cross-provider agents: durable detached/foreground execution, bounded status and cancellation, absolute deadlines, process-group cleanup, honest orphan/replacement safety, ledger-independent shared admission, and exact managed-run receipt binding for formal reviewer evidence. This supersedes heuristic time-window provenance matching such as the inactive B-1be5 proposal; it does not manage native host subagents and must preserve legacy configured provider timeout ceilings.
